about: The error of NLA and TATT against the production FLAMINGO truth (FLAMINGO at every k >= 0.05 h/Mpc), over the error budget. bands[cut][X]: the up and down tolerance for one k range wrong (The IA error budget of Roman cosmic shear: the fractional error eps of the injected IA spectrum, P_X -> P_X [1 + eps f(k)] at every redshift, that moves Omega_m or S8 by 0.3 of its marginalised error. Model agnostic: the analysis model is the truth itself with an IA amplitude and power-law evolution free, with Omega_m and A_s. Shapes f, all of one sign: bump, a Gaussian in ln k of width 0.3 at k; below, a smooth step equal to 1 at all scales larger than k; above, 1 at all scales smaller than k. up / down: the tolerance for the spectrum too high / too low; linear response where the linear tolerance is below 10%, refitted above (nonlinear_tol.py); above about 20% with the cut the values are upper estimates; 1 = no limit within 100%. example1_cov. (analysis/roman_dchi2/v8/clean_budget.py, nonlinear_tol.py.)) errors[cut][model][X]: P^model/P^truth - 1 at the core snapshots (z_core) on k_dense, each model fitted at the fiducial cosmology (IA parameters only) with the same cut (analysis/roman_dchi2/v8/fid_fits.py).
